panels.title: Servers seen
panels.description: Distinct host.name in the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT host) AS "Servers" FROM (
  SELECT resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT resource_attributes->>'host.name' FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT resource_attributes->>'host.name' FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IS NOT NULL
) s
WHERE host IN (${host:sqlstring})

panels.title: Servers up (5m)
panels.description: Hosts with any metric sample in the last 5 minutes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT resource_attributes->>'host.name') AS "Up"
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IS NOT NULL
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Errors"
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})

SELECT avg(value) AS "CPU"
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.cpu.utilization'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})

SELECT avg(value) AS "Memory"
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.memory.utilization'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})

SELECT count(DISTINCT coalesce(resource_attributes->>'service.name', service_name)) AS "Services"
FROM (
  SELECT service_name, resource_attributes FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  UNION ALL
  SELECT service_name, resource_attributes FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
) s
WHERE resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})

panels.title: Server status
panels.description: Click a host, then open Server detail from the top link (set Host filter)

targets.rawSql:
WITH hosts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host
  FROM (
    SELECT resource_attributes FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    UNION ALL
    SELECT resource_attributes FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    UNION ALL
    SELECT resource_attributes FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  ) x
  WHERE resource_attributes->>'host.name' IS NOT NULL
    AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})
),
last_metric AS (
  SELECT resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host,
         max("timestamp") AS last_seen,
         max(resource_attributes->>'service.name') AS service_name
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  GROUP BY 1
),
uptime AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (resource_attributes->>'host.name')
         resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host,
         value AS process_uptime_s
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE metric_name = 'process.uptime'
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  ORDER BY resource_attributes->>'host.name', "timestamp" DESC
),
mem AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (resource_attributes->>'host.name')
         resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host,
         value AS memory_util
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE metric_name = 'process.memory.utilization'
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  ORDER BY resource_attributes->>'host.name', "timestamp" DESC
),
cpu AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (resource_attributes->>'host.name')
         resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host,
         value AS cpu_util
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE metric_name = 'process.cpu.utilization'
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  ORDER BY resource_attributes->>'host.name', "timestamp" DESC
),
errs AS (
  SELECT resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host,
         count(*) AS error_lines
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT h.host,
       coalesce(lm.service_name, '-') AS service,
       lm.last_seen,
       CASE WHEN lm.last_seen > now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN 'UP' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS status,
       round(u.process_uptime_s::numeric, 0) AS process_uptime_s,
       round((c.cpu_util * 100)::numeric, 2) AS cpu_pct,
       round((m.memory_util * 100)::numeric, 2) AS memory_pct,
       coalesce(e.error_lines, 0) AS error_lines
FROM hosts h
LEFT JOIN last_metric lm ON lm.host = h.host
LEFT JOIN uptime u ON u.host = h.host
LEFT JOIN cpu c ON c.host = h.host
LEFT JOIN mem m ON m.host = h.host
LEFT JOIN errs e ON e.host = h.host
ORDER BY status ASC, h.host

SELECT
  "timestamp" AS time,
  resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS metric,
  value
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.uptime'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  "timestamp" AS time,
  resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS metric,
  value
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.cpu.utilization'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  "timestamp" AS time,
  resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS metric,
  value
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.memory.utilization'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval),
  resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  "timestamp",
  resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS host,
  coalesce(resource_attributes->>'service.name', service_name) AS service,
  left(body, 240) AS body
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND resource_attributes->>'host.name' IN (${host:sqlstring})
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 100

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS __text, resource_attributes->>'host.name' AS __value FROM (
  SELECT resource_attributes FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  UNION ALL SELECT resource_attributes FROM otel_metrics_sum
  UNION ALL SELECT resource_attributes FROM otel_logs
) s
WHERE resource_attributes->>'host.name' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1
